Is Google Ads right for your business?

I'd ask three things. Do people search for what you do? Is a new customer worth a decent amount? Can you take on more work right now?

Ads work like a tap. Great when a clinic in Norwood has gaps next week. Pointless when you're booked out until February.

Want to rank higher on Google? Start with three things.

A Business Profile filled in properly with the right main category.
Real reviews coming in steadily, asked for the minute a job's done.
A page on your website for every service you want to be found for.

Slow to build. Then it compounds.

Google's help page on local rankings says you can't request or pay for a better spot on the map.

So I ranked my own business the slow way. Proper profile. Pages that answer real questions. Patience.

Same work I do for clients:
